title: Blackbox Model Provenance via Palimpsestic Membership Inference
authors_zh: Rohith Kuditipudi, Jing Huang, Sally Zhu, Diyi Yang, Christopher Potts, Percy Liang
paper_type_zh: 黑盒模型来源与训练谱系统计审计论文
best_for_zh: 需要审计模型衍生关系、训练谱系与来源证据的研究者。
one_line: 以训练样本随机顺序的相关性，为黑盒衍生模型或文本提供可量化来源证据。
why: It offers a concrete audit surface or failure-mode dataset for Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13 candidate: the central contribution audits contamination, verifier or judge failure, reward hacking, or evaluation reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A model owner may suspect that a black-box model or text stream derives from her open-weight model, but watermarking changes training and similarity tests can false-positive. The paper tests provenance through correlation with the randomized order of the owner’s training examples.

It gives query and text-only observation settings for independence testing. The target is derivative-model provenance and training-lineage audit, not benchmark contamination.

模型所有者可能怀疑黑盒模型或文本流源自自己的开放权重模型，但 watermarking 要改动训练，普通相似度测试也会误报。论文改以与训练样本随机顺序的相关性检验来源。

它给出查询和仅观测文本两种独立性检验设置。目标是衍生模型来源与训练谱系审计，而非基准污染。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The method exploits palimpsestic memorization: later training examples leave stronger traces. If the owner shuffled training data, correlation between a suspect artifact and example order gives statistical evidence against independence. Code and training transcripts are released; this is a transparent, noninvasive provenance-test contract, not a generic membership-inference dataset.
该方法利用“重写式记忆”：较晚训练样本留下更强痕迹。若所有者随机打乱训练数据，嫌疑对象与样本顺序的相关性就构成反驳独立性的统计证据。官方公开代码和训练 transcript；核心是透明、非侵入的来源检验契约，不是通用 membership-inference 数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Record the ordered, randomly shuffled training transcript.
  2. In the query setting, correlate a suspect model's token likelihoods on transcript samples with their training order; a reference model removes natural variation.
  3. In the observational setting, correlate n-gram matches by transcript partition or compare text likelihood under models retrained on independent reshuffles.
  4. Convert the statistic to a p-value or an approximate z-score. Fix transcript order, sample count, reference model, retraining fraction, and temperature.

1. 记录经过随机打乱、但顺序可追溯的训练 transcript。
  2. 查询设置中，将嫌疑模型对样本的 token likelihood 与训练顺序相关；参考模型消除自然难度差异。
  3. 仅观测文本时，按 transcript 分区相关 n-gram 匹配，或比较文本在独立重排后续训模型下的 likelihood。
  4. 将统计量换为 p-value 或近似 z-score。须固定顺序、样本数、参考模型、续训比例和温度。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across 40 Pythia and OLMo derivatives from 1B to 12B parameters, the query test obtains p-values at most 1e-8 in all but six cases. With the reshuffling observation test, retraining on the last 2% of TinyStories pretraining yields p-values below 1e-3 from 320 generated tokens. The observation test is costly and its p-values are approximate.
对 1B 至 12B 的 40 个 Pythia、OLMo 衍生模型，查询检验除 6 例外均得到不高于 1e-8 的 p-value。重排观测检验以 TinyStories 最后 2% 数据续训时，320 个生成 token 即得到低于 1e-3 的 p-value。观测检验成本高，且该 p-value 为近似值。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Canaries modify training, and held-out dataset inference depends on secrecy. This work changes the evidence source to randomized training order, with an exact false-positive guarantee under its shuffle assumption and a text-only extension. The contribution is a provenance test with a formal null.
Canary 需要改动训练，留出集推断依赖保密。本文改以随机训练顺序作为证据源：在 shuffle 假设下给出精确假阳性保证，并扩展到仅观测文本。贡献是带形式化零假设的来源检验。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The owner needs an ordered training transcript, which may be commercially or legally sensitive. Tests require many tokens or retraining multiple models; the reshuffling observation result is approximate. Audit transcript disclosure and cost before using a result for enforcement.
所有者必须持有有序训练 transcript，而它可能涉及商业或法律敏感性。检验需要大量 token 或重训多个模型；重排观测结果为近似。用于执法前应审计 transcript 披露范围与计算成本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it when a developer retains shuffled training order and needs evidence about a suspect derivative. Provide transcript samples and model probabilities, or sufficiently long observed text; report the p-value with null and access assumptions. Do not use it when order is unavailable or an exact observational p-value is required.
当开发者保留随机训练顺序、需要审计嫌疑衍生模型时可用。输入 transcript 样本和模型概率，或足够长的观测文本；报告 p-value、零假设和访问条件。若顺序不可得，或必须获得精确的仅观测文本 p-value，则不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Training order is the provenance signal.
  2. Query access gives exact p-values; observation has two cost tradeoffs.
  3. Code and transcripts are released.
  4. Forty derivative models are the main query evidence.
  5. Check shuffle and transcript access before adoption.

1. 训练顺序是来源信号。
  2. 查询访问给出精确 p-value；观测文本有两类成本权衡。
  3. 官方公开代码和 transcript。
  4. 40 个衍生模型构成主要查询证据。
  5. 采用前先检查 shuffle 和 transcript 访问条件。
